dish.title: Punjabi Rajma Chawal: Kidney Bean Curry with Basmati Rice
dish.description: Red kidney beans simmered in a deeply browned onion, ginger, garlic, and tomato masala until the gravy turns thick and glossy, finished with garam masala and lemon. Served over steamed basmati with cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Punjabi Rajma Chawal: Kidney Bean Curry with Basmati Rice
recipe_version.description: Red kidney beans simmered in a deeply browned onion, ginger, garlic, and tomato masala until the gravy turns thick and glossy, finished with garam masala and lemon. Served over steamed basmati with cilantro.

ingredients.name: Kashmiri or mild red chili powder
ingredients.display_name: Kashmiri or mild red chili powder

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.note: half juiced, half cut into wedges

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, grate the ginger, and slit the chile. Drain and rinse the beans. Rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear. Chop the cilantro. Juice half the lemon and cut the other half into wedges.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 12 minutes; then leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes. The covered cooking and rest run inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Brown the masala base
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 4-quart heavy pot over medium. Add the cumin seeds and bay leaves and let them sizzle a few seconds. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until deep golden-brown, about 12 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, and chile and cook 1 minute. Stir in the coriander, turmeric, and chili powder for a few seconds.

steps.title: Cook the tomatoes
steps.body: Add the crushed tomatoes and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Cook, stirring and scraping the bottom, until the masala thickens and oil shines at the edges, about 7 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.body: Add the beans and 1 1/2 cups water. Simmer, partly covered and stirring now and then, 15 minutes. Crush about a quarter of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken the gravy, stir in the garam masala and lemon juice, and simmer 2 minutes more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves and chile if you like. Fluff the rice, spoon the rajma over it, and finish with cilantro and lemon wedges.
